chunks: And when the mountains are made to move,
ai.seo_question: What happens to the mountains on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (81:2) is often linked with the concept of *Tashabbuh* (resemblance) and the physical transformation of the world, reflecting the divine power to dismantle the established order of creation. It serves as a profound reminder of the transient nature of the material world (*Dunya*) and the certainty of the Hereafter (*Akhirah*), urging believers to prepare spiritually for the ultimate upheaval.
